name: Clara Reyes
source:
Gaia serves as operational support within the Aegis, thanks to a sensitivity that allows her to perceive details imperceptible to others. Quiet and introspective by nature, she prefers listening and observing over taking part directly.

Raised by her mother in a modest and reserved environment, she developed a deep sensory connection with nature from a young age — becoming highly perceptive, yet emotionally distant from people, whose dynamics she struggles to understand.
She's not shy; she simply chooses to stay on the sidelines.

[In game description]
